notes.title: Ghostbane Release Date and Prolugue Major Update
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2645490?utm_source=homepage&utm_campaign=Prologue2

Ghostbane will be released in Early Access on Steam on October 7th. We are excited to bring you our game, which has been a long time in the making, as Early Access. Our game has come a long way thanks to your feedback and support throughout the development process. 

With this update, many bugs have been fixed and performance has been improved. You can experience the changes in this update and provide feedback via [url=https://discord.gg/BVXgVmUvQY][b]Discord[/b][/url]. Thank you for your support during the development of the game.

You can follow us on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/PiBit][b]Developer Page[/b][/url].

notes.title: Ghostbane: Prolugue Major Update
notes.notes:
[b]Ghostbane: Prolugue[/b] continues to receive regular updates. By adding new content to the prolugue version, which is the introductory part of the game, and [i]fixing bugs[/i] reported via [url=https://discord.gg/K8wKZVwqsC][b]Discord[/b][/url], we continue to keep it update and playable without bugs.

[h1]What's in this big update?[/h1]

[list]
[*]The texts in the [b]ritual tablet[/b] have been[b] localised[/b] in [b]many languages![/b] Now you can perform rituals in your [b]own language[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012323/132d168d9ad98b2cf4b0e465f342e960db0dc8c6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012323/984d64d2792d131d5f8b3a56ffddb1ebe169b64f.png[/img]

[*][i]No more lost items[/i]: You can now [b]teleport[/b] items to [b]this area[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012323/48363985c16056ea3513ecb611bcbbe28fdac3bc.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012323/463c06120273d5c8d0ec297e1f3e342709b25271.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Ghost names[/b] have been [b]localised[/b] in [b]many languages[/b]. The screen with the [i]names[/i] of the captured [i]ghosts[/i] is back. [i](Much more coming soon...)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012323/d849040c259b5a7e82a94675b7da79a440ba899a.jpg[/img]

[*]Fixed bugs in earning rewards and experience for finishing the game. You can now earn experience and money when you finish the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012323/c8c46adabc83d8330b148cad4622649ef444c5ec.jpg[/img]

[*]Fixed problems with the [b]ghost's[/b] [i]appearance[/i], [i]attack[/i] and [i]movement[/i].

[*]Many problems with [b]death[/b] and [b]revive[/b] have been solved. Fixed bugs with [b]captured dragons[/b].

[*]Fixed bugs when [i]entering[/i] and[i] exiting[/i] [b]screens[/b].

[*]The [b]thermometer[/b] now gives evidence more easily. You can find your [i]favourite room faster[/i].

[*][b]Russian, German[/b] and [b]French[/b] translations have been corrected.

[*]The ambient light has been slightly increased in the [b]main lobby[/b] and [b]Mansion map[/b].

[*][i]Lighting power[/i] of the [b]Flashlight[/b] has been increased.

[*]Fixed the issue where [i]items dropped[/i] on the [b]Mansion map[/b] would disappear.

[*]Some sounds remained on in the background even if they were switched off. [i]Sound settings[/i] errors have been fixed.

[*]Fixed issues with placing the [b]kittybane[/b] and [b]ghostbane weapon[/b] on the truck.

[*][b]Version[/b] information field has been added.

[*]Fixed bugs in the [b]camera particle[/b].

[*]Fixed issues with [b]UI[/b] overlap.

[*]Many minor bugs and performance improvements.

[/list]
